name: Brandenburg-Prussia
title: The Kingdom of Brandenburg-Prussia
pressure_shape: Fast Invader Deck: from L2 a Stage III card sits between Stage I and Stage II, and L3-L6 remove Stage I/II cards (8 cards at L6); Land Rush Escalation adds Towns; no additional loss condition.

stage_ii_escalation.title: Land Rush
stage_ii_escalation.text: (Before Exploring) On each board with Town/City, add 1 Town to a land without Town.

sources: Level titles and text: Steam engine defs (TheKingdomOfBrandenburgPrussia), icon tokens written as words, formatting tags removed. Cross-checked against data/references/rules/register.md section 4.1 (Wiki copy). Difficulty and fear decks: box panel values (Brett, 2026-10-19); fear deck = 3 per Terror Level plus the engine offsets. Levels are cumulative: level N applies levels 1..N. is_cliff is unset pending a strategy review.

levels.name: Base
levels.escalation: Escalation (Land Rush): (Before Exploring) On each board with Town/City, add 1 Town to a land without Town. Additional loss condition: none.
levels.notes: R-ADV-BP-L0a, R-ADV-BP-L0b. Escalation happens before Exploring; its Town can be an Explore source that turn (Wiki ruling; NQ-G). Players choose the land (Q21).

levels.name: Fast Start
levels.escalation: During Setup, on each board add 1 Town to land #3.

levels.name: Surge of Colonists
levels.escalation: When making the Invader Deck, put 1 of the Stage III cards between Stage I and Stage II. (New Deck Order: 111-3-2222-3333)
levels.notes: R-ADV-BP-L2. Open (NQ-P): whether the moved card counts as Stage III or as the slot's Stage for Stage-keyed effects. With a combined adversary, move the bottom-most Stage III card just below the bottom-most Stage I card (Q19).

levels.name: Efficient
levels.escalation: When making the Invader Deck, remove an additional Stage I card. (New Deck Order: 11-3-2222-3333)

levels.name: Aggressive Timetable
levels.escalation: When making the Invader Deck, remove an additional Stage II card. (New Deck Order: 11-3-222-3333)

levels.name: Ruthlessly Efficient
levels.escalation: When making the Invader Deck, remove an additional Stage I card. (New Deck Order: 1-3-222-3333)

levels.name: Terrifyingly Efficient
levels.escalation: When making the Invader Deck, remove all Stage I cards. (New Deck Order: 3-222-3333)
levels.notes: R-ADV-BP-L6. Engine removes one more Stage I card; after L3 and L5 that is the last one.
